published.name: Seven Stars
published.description: A contemporary Chinese restaurant on Centre Road in Bentleigh East, running for 22 years as a family-oriented eatery. The menu is casual and affordable, served to families, friends and business diners alike in a quiet dining area. Take-away is available, along with a catering service for private functions. Lunch runs Tuesday to Saturday, with dinner Tuesday through Sunday; closed Mondays except on public holidays.
published.meritSplit: local: Generic contemporary Chinese restaurant with no specific dishes, chef or identity named beyond stock marketing language.

published.name: Chicci
published.description: A woodfire pizzeria and bar on Kew's High Street, trading as Chicci Cucina Woodfire Pizzeria Bar. Pizzas come from a wood-fired oven, giving a crisp crust with a smoky edge, alongside pastas, salads, antipasti and desserts drawn from seasonal produce. The kitchen leans on Italian cooking and local producers, and the bar keeps a relaxed setting for lunch, dinner or drinks.
published.meritSplit: local: Generic wood-fired pizzeria with boilerplate marketing copy and no distinctive identity, recipes, or named operator.

published.name: Piece of Cake Bakery
published.description: A European patisserie in Oakleigh East, operated by Kun and Jenny, who work from original recipes and traditional methods. Everything is baked on-site from scratch: cakes, sourdough croissants and bread, puff pastry pies, New York baked cheesecakes and patisseries.

published.name: Cafelito
published.description:
A coffee bar and catering kitchen in Clayton, trading as Cafelito under DAWANG Catering, serving Melbourne businesses and residents for over five years.

The breakfast menu runs to big brekkies with eggs, bacon, chorizo, mushrooms and sourdough, a vegetarian version with feta and avocado, and breakfast bruschetta with smashed avocado and poached eggs. A lunch menu uses locally sourced, seasonal produce. Alongside dine-in service, the kitchen handles custom catering for events, from intimate gatherings to corporate conferences.
published.meritSplit: local: Generic catering/coffee bar with standard cafe menu and no distinctive identity, produce, or maker to speak of.

published.name: Il Lido
published.description: Housed in what was once the 1930s art-deco Lido Cabaret hall on Cottesloe Beach, this Italian-inspired espresso bar and restaurant takes its name from the Italian for "the beach". The kitchen leans on cucina povera: pasta, pastries, aperitivo and espresso to grab and go. The wine list has drawn recognition, named Australia's Best Listing of Italian Wines and a finalist for Australia's Wine List of the Year. Bookings help, but walk-ins are welcome.

published.name: IndigiScapes
published.description: Run by Redland City Council, this centre in Capalaba sits within the council's environment and sustainability programs, alongside its native gardening and wildlife work. The source material is thin on detail beyond its place on Redlands Coast.

published.name: Kuche
published.description: A café on High Street in Kew East serving Seven Seeds specialty coffee alongside cakes and pastries. The kitchen caters to a range of dietary requirements, including gluten free, vegan, vegetarian, dairy free, nut free and low FODMAP, and offers savoury and sweet catering items for larger occasions. Open weekdays from early morning through the afternoon, with shorter hours on Saturdays and closed on public holidays.
published.meritSplit: local: Generic neighbourhood cafe serving third-party Seven Seeds coffee with no distinctive identity, house specialty or notable maker.

published.name: Mamma Mia Trattoria Pizzeria
published.description: A family-run restaurant on Shore Street in Cleveland, serving authentic Northern and Southern cuisine prepared with high-quality ingredients that reflect the family's Italian origins.

published.name: Remnscnt Cafe
published.description: A café and gift shop on Glen Huntly Road, combining a kitchen with a boutique of gifts, flowers, candles and jewellery. The menu runs to savoury items such as a ham and cheese panini, pesto pasta salad and the Chill Scramble, alongside waffles and croissants, with a sandwich and salad cabinet kept stocked through the afternoon. There is both indoor and outdoor seating. The kitchen serves Monday to Saturday from 7:30am and Sunday from 8:30am, closing at 2pm, with the cabinet available until close.
published.meritSplit: local: Generic café-with-gift-shop serving panini, pesto pasta salad and croissants with no distinctive food, maker or identity of its own.

published.name: Sushi Hakuba
published.description:
An independent sushi shop opened by operators who spent 18 years running a franchise conveyor belt restaurant. The kitchen works in the kaiten-zushi tradition, selecting fish each morning and building each piece by hand. The chefs aim for the flavours and dishes current in Japan today rather than a fixed idea of tradition.

Found in The Pines Shopping Centre on Guineas Creek Road, Elanora, with takeaway available for pick up.
